Section 5 sentence matches. DonHang.Api is a separate project referencing DonHang.Domain.

OrderServiceTests.cs:14-21: `var repository = new FakeOrderRepository(); var notifier = new FakeNotifier(); var service = new OrderService(repository, notifier); var order = await service.PlaceOrderAsync(customerId: 1, items: [OneItem]); Assert.Equal("new", order.Status); Assert.Equal(1, order.CustomerId);`

FakeOrderRepository.cs:8 `public sealed class FakeOrderRepository : IOrderRepository` (namespace DonHang.Tests); FakeNotifier.cs:6 `public sealed class FakeNotifier : INotifier`; EfOrderRepository.cs:7 `EfOrderRepository(DonHangDbContext db) : IOrderRepository`; LoggingNotifier.cs:9 `LoggingNotifier(ILogger<LoggingNotifier> logger) : INotifier` (namespace DonHang.Infrastructure).

OrderService.cs:6 `public sealed class OrderService(IOrderRepository repository, INotifier notifier)`; body of PlaceOrderAsync/CancelOrderAsync contains no type check, caller check or flag. Program.cs:19 `AddScoped<OrderService>()` registers the same class for the API; OrderServiceTests.cs:16 constructs it directly.
OrderService.cs:10 `if (items.Count == 0) throw new ArgumentException("an order needs at least one item");`. OrdersController.Create (lines 19-28) has no item-count check.

Ran `git grep -n "interface " stage-1 -- DonHang.Domain DonHang.Api` in examples/don-hang: exactly two lines, `DonHang.Domain/INotifier.cs:5:public interface INotifier` and `DonHang.Domain/IOrderRepository.cs:5:public interface IOrderRepository`. Nothing in DonHang.Api.

Factual half checked in the repo: DonHang.Api.csproj has ProjectReference to DonHang.Domain; DonHang.Domain.csproj has no ProjectReference, so Api->Domain points toward the core with no interface. The second half is an opinion with an explicit condition ("when you want to test a controller alone"), stated as such in the lesson body.

DonHang.Tests.csproj references only DonHang.Domain (no DonHang.Api), and OrderServiceTests calls service.PlaceOrderAsync directly, so no code in OrdersController is on the test's call path. The test-only-flag half is conditioned reasoning, not a version-dependent fact.
